beats.action:
— HARD HOOK
FIRST FRAME:
Luca has JUST thrown the red ball at the wooden wall.
Instead of bouncing back, the ball is already STUCK flat to the wall.
Luca is frozen with both hands half-raised, eyes wide.
The impossible sticky ball must dominate the opening.

SFX: THWIP — STICK.

— REACTION
Luca walks straight to the ball and pulls it with one hand.
It will not move.
He uses both hands.

— FIRST ATTEMPT
Luca pulls harder.
The ball stretches toward him like soft chewing gum while its center remains stuck to the wall.
He lets go.

SNAP!
The ball instantly returns to the wall.

— ESCALATION
Luca grabs the ball again with both hands and leans backward.
This time the BALL stays stuck and the WOODEN WALL itself flexes slightly toward Luca like soft rubber.
Luca’s eyes widen.
He immediately releases it.

BOING!
The wall returns safely to normal.

— SECOND ATTEMPT
The ball finally drops from the wall by itself.
Luca catches it.
He squeezes it gently.
It behaves like a normal ball.
He smiles.

— FAKE RESOLUTION
Luca carefully tosses the ball once between his hands.
Normal.
He relaxes.

— FINAL TWIST
Luca gives the ball one tiny playful toss upward.
It drops directly onto his CHEEK and sticks there with a soft PLUP.
Luca goes cross-eyed trying to look at it.

PLUP! — HARD CUT.

SAFETY
The ball is soft.
It sticks to Luca’s cheek only, never covering his nose or mouth.

DIALOGUE
None.

NO narrator.
NO text overlay.
NO logo.
NO watermark.

beats.action:
— FIRST-FRAME HOOK
--------------------------------------------------
START EXACTLY FROM THE PROVIDED IMAGE.

Luca is already recoiling in surprise.
The crocodile’s huge open mouth is already full of colourful soft balls.

Immediately:
PTOO!

ONE colourful ball shoots out of the crocodile’s mouth toward Luca.

Luca flinches and catches/blocks it with both hands.

No pause.

--------------------------------------------------

— FIRST ACTION
--------------------------------------------------
Luca quickly tosses that ONE ball back into the crocodile’s open mouth.

GULP.

The crocodile freezes for half a beat.
Its cheeks puff slightly.

PTOO-PTOO-PTOO!

It spits out THREE colourful balls in quick succession.

Luca dodges one, catches one, and one bounces off the grass beside him.

Keep the action fast and readable.

--------------------------------------------------

— ESCALATION
--------------------------------------------------
Luca grabs TWO nearby balls and throws BOTH back into the crocodile’s mouth.

GULP-GULP.

The crocodile’s cheeks puff much bigger.

For one short beat, everything is silent.

Then:

PTOO-PTOO-PTOO-PTOO-PTOO-PTOO!

A burst of SIX soft balls fires out rapidly.

Luca jumps backward while balls bounce around his feet.

--------------------------------------------------

— LUCA TRIES TO STOP IT
--------------------------------------------------
Luca raises both hands as if saying “enough.”

He carefully picks up only ONE ball.

He slowly rolls it toward the crocodile instead of throwing it.

The crocodile gently catches it.

GULP.

Luca waits nervously.

--------------------------------------------------

— FAKE RESOLUTION
--------------------------------------------------
The crocodile returns exactly ONE ball.

PTOO.

Luca catches it.

Both Luca and the crocodile relax.

The crocodile closes its mouth and smiles innocently.

Luca smiles with relief.

Hold this calm moment for LESS THAN ONE SECOND.

--------------------------------------------------

— HUGE FINAL TWIST
--------------------------------------------------
The crocodile suddenly gets a strange hiccup.

HIC!

Its cheeks inflate enormously.

Luca’s smile disappears.

Then:

PTOO-PTOO-PTOO-PTOO-PTOO!

A ridiculous FOUNTAIN of colourful soft balls blasts upward from the crocodile’s mouth and rains across the garden.

Dozens of balls bounce everywhere.

Luca tries to dodge them but becomes surrounded up to his shoulders.

At the final moment, only Luca’s shocked face is visible between bouncing colourful balls.

HARD CUT while balls are still falling.

No fade-out.

--------------------------------------------------
MOTION / RETENTION RULES
--------------------------------------------------
- Something physical must happen every 1–2 seconds.
- Luca must actively catch, throw, dodge, step back, roll, and react.
- Do NOT make Luca stand still watching for long periods.
- Do NOT add a second absurd rule.
- Do NOT grow or shrink the crocodile.
- Do NOT grow or shrink Luca.
- Do NOT transform the garden.
- Only the NUMBER OF BALLS increases.
- The escalation must feel obvious: 1 ball → 3 balls → 6 balls → huge final fountain.
- Ball motion must be large and easy to read on a phone screen.
- Keep the crocodile friendly and funny.
- No dangerous contact with Luca.
- No biting.
- No sharp attack behavior.

--------------------------------------------------
AUDIO / SOUND DESIGN
--------------------------------------------------
No dialogue.
No narrator.
No lip-sync.

Use clear comedy sound effects:
- soft GULP for balls entering
- playful PTOO for balls exiting
- light BOING sounds when balls bounce
- one comic HIC before the final fountain

Background music:
Fast playful absurd preschool comedy, around 118 BPM.
Pizzicato strings + marimba + soft percussion.
Music builds slightly with each multiplication step.
Brief near-silence before the final fountain.
No vocals.

--------------------------------------------------
NEGATIVE / DO NOT GENERATE
--------------------------------------------------
NO text overlay.
NO subtitles.
NO logo.
NO captions.
NO pond.
NO water.
NO extra children.
NO scary crocodile behavior.
NO biting.
NO chasing.
NO camera spin.
NO scene change.
NO random objects.
NO body deformation.
NO extra limbs.
NO character redesign.

--------------------------------------------------

Start immediately.

Kiko runs toward a chair to sit down.

Legs pointing into the air.

Kiko is already halfway into the sitting motion before noticing.

She freezes inches above it.

Eyes huge.

She blurts:

“WHAT?!”

NO establishing shot.
The upside-down chair must dominate the first frame.

--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------

Kiko points:

“A CHAIR!”

Then looks confused.

She says clearly:

“It’s upside down!”

She grabs the chair and flips it correctly.

--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------

Kiko smiles proudly.

“Up… down!”

She points upward while saying UP.
Then downward while saying DOWN.

She turns around to sit.

--------------------------------------------------

— FIRST ESCALATION
--------------------------------------------------

The instant Kiko turns away—

FLIP!

The chair turns upside down by itself.

Kiko sits toward empty space and catches herself at the last second.

She spins around.

--------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------

Kiko flips it back.

She stares directly at the chair.

Chair stays normal.

Kiko slowly turns her head away.

FLIP!

She immediately looks back.

Chair is upside down.

--------------------------------------------------

— COMEDY PAYOFF
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko becomes determined.

She keeps staring at the chair.

She slowly walks backward toward it without looking away.

She says:

“Stay DOWN!”

The chair behaves.

Kiko smiles.

--------------------------------------------------

— TWIST + LOOP
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko finally sits.

The ENTIRE chair suddenly flips upside down WITH Kiko on it.

Kiko ends upside down and shouts:

“AGAIN?!”

Cut immediately.

Loop back to the first upside-down chair.

--------------------------------------------------
MANDATORY SPOKEN DIALOGUE / LIP-SYNC LOCK
--------------------------------------------------

Exact English dialogue REQUIRED:

Kiko:
“WHAT?!”

Kiko:
“A CHAIR!”

Kiko:
“It’s upside down!”

Kiko:
“Up… down!”

Kiko:
“Stay DOWN!”

Kiko:
“AGAIN?!”

All lines must be clearly audible English.

Visible mouth movement.
Accurate lip-sync.

Do not:
- remove dialogue
- translate it
- replace dialogue with subtitles
- create a silent version
- add narration

--------------------------------------------------
INSTAGRAM RETENTION RULES
--------------------------------------------------

Something must change every 1–2 seconds.

The problem must be understandable without sound.

Do not make the chair movement subtle.

Chair flips must be fast and visually obvious.

No moral lesson.
No slow ending.
No waiting after final joke.
No text generated inside scene.

beats.action:
Kiko switches on the lamp and starts to read or look at the table.
She turns her head away for a moment.
The lamp switches off.
Kiko turns back and says: "Hmm?"

Kiko switches it on again and stares at it.
It stays on.
She slowly looks away.
It switches off again.

Kiko quickly spins back and points at it.
She says: "I saw that!"

Kiko gets clever.
She uses a small mirror or reflective object to “watch” the lamp indirectly.
The lamp stays on.
Kiko smiles proudly and says: "Aha!"

Just as Kiko celebrates, a second small light in the room flickers on or off instead.
Kiko looks toward it, surprised.

When Kiko looks back at the main lamp, it is off again.
She lunges back toward it, matching the opening rhythm for loop.

SOUND:

beats.action:
Mimi happily reaches for the box and opens it.
She expects a cracker.
Inside is an apple instead.
Mimi says: "Snack time!"

Mimi closes and reopens the box.
Now there is a banana or spoon inside.
Mimi blinks and says: "What?"

Mimi closes and opens it again.
Now a silly wrong item appears, like a sock or block.
Mimi becomes determined.

Mimi turns the box slightly, taps it, closes it carefully, then opens it.
Finally, the cracker appears.
Mimi points proudly and says: "There!"

Mimi reaches in to grab the cracker.
The lid suddenly flips shut or the cracker pops back down out of reach.

Mimi reopens the box and sees another wrong item again.
She reacts and immediately leans in for another try, matching the opening rhythm for loop.

Small lid open/close sounds, light table taps, cute object swap sounds.
No heavy music.
Dialogue must be clear.

extra characters, spooky magic, talking box, scary object changes, crying, long final hold, text, subtitles, logo, watermark, cuts, zoom.

beats.action:
- HOOK
Luca lies on soft sand. A wave splashes nearby. A tropical bird calls loudly.
Luca bolts upright.
Luca: "WHERE AM I?!"
Guest steps in holding a coconut.
Guest: "An island."

Luca looks around: palm trees, bright sea, map sticking from pocket.
Luca: "Adventure!"
Guest: "First... survival."

- COMEDY MONTAGE
Luca tries opening a coconut. It rolls away.
He tries fishing. Fish steals the bait.
He builds a shelter. One leaf falls onto his head.
Luca: "I'm usually GOOD at exploring!"
Guest laughs: "Different island."

They find a small cave. Inside: an old wooden chest.
Luca: "TREASURE!"
He opens it.
Inside: a blank journal and pencil.
Luca: "A notebook?"
Guest: "Every adventure needs a story."

Luca writes and draws on the beach.
Luca: "Today... I became an island explorer."
Wind turns a page.

- TWIST
SMASH CUT: Luca wakes in his own bed.
Luca: "A dream?"
Then notices the SAME journal in his hand.
He stares at camera.
CUT.

No narration. No on-screen text.
